description: CDC FluView weekly influenza-like illness (ILI) and weighted ILI for the US or a region (served via Delphi Epidata, which mirrors CDC FluView): epiweek, ILI %, weighted ILI %, patient and provider counts. Give an epiweek range of up to 12 weeks. No outbreak maps. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

epiweekTo.description: Last epiweek, YYYYWW, at most 12 weeks after the first

region.description: 'nat' for US national, or a state code like 'vt' (lowercase letters, 2 to 5 characters)
